## Image Recognition function

The following code is made with help of ChatGPT and manual correction. The input can be any online image url.

```{r}
# Install/load required packages
if (!require(torchvision, quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("torchvision", repos = "https://cloud.r-project.org")
if (!require(jpeg, quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("jpeg", repos = "https://cloud.r-project.org")

# Set a garbage collector
options(torch.threshold_call_gc = 4000)
library(torch)
library(torchvision)
library(jpeg)
```

```{r}
image_classify_resnet18 <- function(img_url) {
  # Load Pretrained ResNet18 Model
  model <- model_resnet18(pretrained = TRUE)
  model$eval()
  
  # Download & Preprocess Image
  img_path <- tempfile(fileext = ".jpg")
  download.file(img_url, destfile = img_path, mode = "wb")
  
  img <- readJPEG(img_path)
  img <- torch_tensor(img)$permute(c(3, 1, 2))  # (H,W,C) → (C,H,W)
  
  # Apply preprocessing (resize, crop, normalize)
  img <- transform_resize(img, 256)
  img <- transform_center_crop(img, 224)
  img <- transform_normalize(
    img,
    mean = c(0.485, 0.456, 0.406),
    std = c(0.229, 0.224, 0.225)
  )
  img <- img$unsqueeze(1) # Add batch dimension
  
  # Run Inference
  with_no_grad({
    output <- model(img)
  })
  
  probabilities <- nnf_softmax(output, dim = 2)
  top5 <- probabilities$topk(5)
  
  # Load ImageNet Labels & Print Top-5 Predictions
  labels_url <- "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pytorch/hub/master/imagenet_classes.txt"
  labels <- readLines(labels_url, warn = FALSE)
  
  cat("\nTop-5 Predictions:\n")
  for (i in 1:5) {
    idx <- as.integer(top5[[2]][1, i])
    score <- as.numeric(top5[[1]][1, i]) * 100
    cat(sprintf("%d. %s: %.2f%%\n", i, labels[idx], score))
  }
}
```

Try golden retriever:

```{r}
image_classify_resnet18("https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/3/31/Golden-retriever-dog-1362597631o6g.jpg")
```

Try Abyssinian cat:

```{r}
image_classify_resnet18("https://cdn.wamiz.fr/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,quality=80,width=532,height=532,fit=cover/animal/breed/cat/adult/6735e079d0977523978416.jpg")
```

Try zebra:

```{r}
image_classify_resnet18("https://www.sciencing.com/sciencing/characteristics-zebra-8001369/153717005.jpg")
```
